question: Three numbers are coprime to each other such that the product of the first two numbers is 88 and that of the last two numbers is 165. The sum of all three numbers is:
solution:
**Given:**

Product of the first two numbers is 88 and that of the last two numbers is 165

**Concept used:**

Co-prime numbers have no prime factors in common so when expressed as fraction there will be no simplification

**Calculation:**

Let the numbers be A, B and C respectively

A × B = 88 and B × C = 165

(A × B)/(B × C) = 88/165

A/C = 8/15

So,

A = 8 and C = 15

B = 88/A

⇒ 11

Sum of the numbers = 8 + 11 + 15 = 34

**∴ The sum of all three numbers is 34**
